title: Project Hail Mary
extract: Project Hail Mary is a 2021 hard science fiction novel by American writer Andy Weir. It centers on science teacher and former biologist Ryland Grace, who wakes up aboard a spacecraft, afflicted with amnesia.

Project Hail Mary received generally positive reviews and was a finalist for the 2022 Hugo Award for Best Novel. The unabridged audiobook was read by Ray Porter and won the 2022 Audie Award for Audiobook of the Year.

The novel was adapted into a film of the same name starring Ryan Gosling, Sandra Hüller, and James Ortiz (as the voice of Rocky, and one of the five puppeteers). Drew Goddard wrote the screenplay (his second Andy Weir adaptation), and Phil Lord and Christopher Miller co-directed. It was released in theaters on March 20, 2026.
As of the week ending July 11, 2026, the book has been featured on the New York Times' best-seller list for 57 weeks in total.
